title: Skills catch-up for a late start
caption: A fresh Lv 39 Assassin now sees Heart Gore 1 → 10 as one step with its specialty, instead of one level at a time.

title: Next up names the whole skill jump
caption: At Lv 39 Next up leads with "Catch up: level Heart Gore 1 → 10" and one Mark spent for the whole jump.

title: Catch-up after three taps
caption: After three taps on a phone, the Skills card shows the fourth skill's jump; each tap can be undone from the toast.

title: Lv 45 join with 180 stones
caption: A Lv 45 join holding 180 Wisdom Stones catches up 13 skills in 13 taps.
